description: GPT-2 is withheld as too dangerous, sparking the openness vs safety war. OpenAI becomes capped-profit and takes $1B from Microsoft. XLNet, RoBERTa, T5 and AlphaStar close the pre-GPT-3 era.

events.title: Transformer-XL breaks fixed context
events.summary: Zihang Dai et al. posted arXiv:1901.02860 introducing segment-level recurrence plus relative positional encodings to cache hidden states, learning dependencies 80% longer than RNNs and 450% longer than vanilla Transformers. It set SOTA perplexity on enwiki8, text8 and WikiText-103. Backbone for XLNet and long-context LLMs.
events.significance: First credible fix for the 512-token limit that constrained GPT-1 and BERT.

events.title: AlphaStar beats StarCraft II pros
events.summary: DeepMind revealed in a January 24 livestream (games played December 2018) that AlphaStar — transformer torso plus LSTM core trained by imitation plus league self-play on 16 TPUs for 14 days — beat Team Liquid's MaNa 5-0 and TLO, 10-1 overall. First AI to beat pros in a full real-time strategy game with imperfect information and 10^26 possible actions.
events.significance: Hardest game-AI milestone to date; Grandmaster version followed in October.

events.title: US Executive Order on Maintaining American Leadership in AI
events.summary: President Trump signed EO 13859 launching the American AI Initiative directing federal agencies to prioritize AI R&D funding, data and cloud access, NIST standards, workforce training and international norms. First US national AI strategy, responding to China's 2017 plan. Led to increased DoD and NSF budgets labs relied on.
events.significance: Start of US industrial policy for AI that runs through the 2023 EO and 2025 Action Plan.

events.title: GPT-2 announced but withheld as too dangerous
events.summary: OpenAI unveiled GPT-2: 1.5B-parameter decoder Transformer, 10x GPT-1, trained on 40GB WebText to predict next word, SOTA on 7 of 8 zero-shot language tasks. Citing misuse for fake news, spam and impersonation, it released only the 124M small model, launching a staged-release experiment and a global safety vs openness debate.
events.significance: Founding drama of AI safety publishing norms; every later gated release cites this.

events.title: OpenAI creates capped-profit OpenAI LP
events.summary: OpenAI announced a shift from nonprofit to capped-profit LP controlled by the nonprofit board, capping first investors at 100x with excess to the nonprofit, with Sam Altman as CEO. Citing need for billions in Azure compute and talent, it enabled equity fundraising while claiming mission primacy. Critics saw the end of openness.
events.significance: Legal structure that enabled the Microsoft deal and caused the 2023 board crisis.

events.title: EU Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI
events.summary: The EU High-Level Expert Group published Ethics Guidelines defining 7 requirements: human agency, robustness, privacy, transparency, diversity, societal well-being and accountability. It framed human-centric trustworthy AI versus US and China approaches, influencing the later AI Act.
events.significance: Philosophical blueprint for the EU AI Act agreed in 2023.

events.title: OpenAI Five defeats world champions OG
events.summary: At the OpenAI Five Finals in San Francisco, Five — training continuously since June 2018, 45,000 years of self-play — beat reigning TI8 champions OG 2-0 live on stream, the first AI to beat esports world champions live. It showed transfer across patches and drafting. OpenAI then opened Five Arena to the public.
events.significance: Redemption for the 2018 loss; peak of game-RL before the pivot to language.

events.title: Sparse Transformer for million-length sequences
events.summary: Rewon Child et al. posted arXiv:1904.10080 factorizing attention with sparse patterns to handle sequences up to 1M tokens in O(n sqrt n). It set SOTA on CIFAR-10, Enwik8 and ImageNet64. It showed a path to long-context scaling later used in GPT-3 and Longformer.
events.significance: Conceptual ancestor of all long-context work culminating in 1M-token Gemini.

events.title: OpenAI Five Arena beats public 99.4%
events.summary: OpenAI opened Five Arena April 18-21 for anyone to play versus Five; results April 22: 7,215 wins and 42 losses (99.4%), 35,466 co-op games, 30,937 players, 10.7 years of play in 3 days. It revealed robustness with few exploits. Announced as the final public Dota demo to refocus on general RL and language.
events.significance: Largest human-vs-AI experiment to date at the time.

events.title: Talk to Transformer goes viral
events.summary: Developer Adam King launched TalkToTransformer.com giving a free web UI to GPT-2 355M generation. Millions experimented, memes and fake-news demos proliferated, pressuring OpenAI's staged narrative. It demonstrated demand for accessible LLM demos, precursor to ChatGPT.
events.significance: Proof that demos drive adoption more than papers.

events.title: GROVER neural fake news defense
events.summary: Rowan Zellers et al. posted Defending Against Neural Fake News training a 1.5B GROVER generator plus detector, finding the best defense is the generator itself (92% detection). Like GPT-2, large weights were withheld. It validated OpenAI's concerns and pushed detection research.
events.significance: ाएकेडमिक counterpart to GPT-2's misuse analysis.

events.title: XLNet generalized autoregressive pretraining
events.summary: Zhilin Yang et al. released XLNet-Large (340M) combining permutation LM plus Transformer-XL to learn bidirectional context without BERT's mask discrepancy, trained on 33B words. It outperformed BERT-Large on 20 tasks and set SOTA on 18 including SQuAD 2.0 and RACE. It reignited the autoregressive vs autoencoding debate.
events.significance: Brief SOTA that proved autoregression could match BERT, paving the way for GPT-2 acceptance.

events.title: Microsoft invests $1B in OpenAI
events.summary: Microsoft and OpenAI announced a multiyear exclusive: $1B into OpenAI LP, Azure as exclusive cloud plus a joint supercomputer, Microsoft as preferred commercialization partner licensing pre-AGI tech. Framed on shared ethics to build AGI for climate, health and education. It gave OpenAI compute to train GPT-3 and anchored the Big Tech-lab alignment era.
events.significance: Most consequential cloud-lab deal; basis for Copilot, Bing Chat and the 2023-2025 race.

events.title: RoBERTa robustly optimized BERT
events.summary: Yinhan Liu et al. posted arXiv:1907.11692 replicating BERT with dynamic masking, removing next-sentence prediction, larger batches (8k), more data (160GB) and longer training on 1024 V100s. It found BERT significantly undertrained; RoBERTa matched or exceeded XLNet on GLUE, SQuAD 2.0 and RACE. It showed training recipe matters more than architecture.
events.significance: Shifted focus from novel architectures to data and training at scale.

events.title: CTRL conditional Transformer
events.summary: Salesforce released CTRL: 1.63B conditional LM with 50 control codes (domain, style, date, URLs) trained on 140GB. It enabled controllable generation without fine-tuning. First large open controllable LLM, foreshadowing instruction-tuning and system prompts.
events.significance: Ancestor of system prompts and instruction following.

events.title: ALBERT lite BERT with parameter sharing
events.summary: Zhenzhong Lan et al. posted arXiv:1909.11942 introducing factorized embeddings plus cross-layer sharing plus sentence-order loss, cutting BERT-Large 334M to 18M while allowing 233M xxlarge scaling. It set SOTA on GLUE, RACE and SQuAD with fewer parameters. It pushed parameter-efficiency that enabled later scaling.
events.significance: Showed bigger is not the only path; efficiency matters.

events.title: DistilBERT distilled BERT
events.summary: Victor Sanh et al. posted arXiv:1910.01108 distilling BERT-Base via triple loss during pretraining into a 6-layer 66M model — 40% smaller, 60% faster, retaining 97% of performance. It showed on-device NLP viable with cheaper pretraining and became the default efficient baseline.
events.significance: Popularized knowledge distillation for LLMs; Hugging Face's breakout research contribution.

events.title: T5 Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer and C4
events.summary: Colin Raffel et al. posted arXiv:1910.10683 unifying all NLP as text-to-text with a systematic study of objectives and architectures, plus the Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus (C4). T5-11B achieved SOTA on GLUE, SuperGLUE, SQuAD, summarization and translation. Released dataset, models and code, framing the pretrain-then-finetune scaling that culminated in GPT-3.
events.significance: Dataset (C4) and text-to-text framing underpin FLAN, T0 and instruction tuning.

events.title: AlphaStar Grandmaster level on Battle.net ladder
events.summary: DeepMind published a Nature paper showing a new AlphaStar with camera input and APM limits, playing all three races on the Battle.net ladder and reaching Grandmaster (top 0.2%). It used automated league plus supervised plus multi-agent RL with released replays. It proved human-constrained superhuman RTS play.
events.significance: Closed the StarCraft chapter with a fair, constrained evaluation.

events.title: StyleGAN2 improved quality and invertibility
events.summary: Karras et al. posted arXiv:1912.04958 analyzing StyleGAN droplet artifacts, redesigning normalization and progressive growing plus path-length regularization for invertibility. It improved FID and eased editing and inversion. It cemented the StyleGAN family as SOTA unconditional image model before the diffusion era.
events.significance: Last GAN peak before DDPM and diffusion overtake in 2020-2022.
